# Contributing to Example

Thank you for your interest.

## AI-generated code policy

This project does not accept AI-generated contributions. All code must
be human-authored. Pull requests suspected of containing AI-generated
material will be closed without review.

## How to contribute

1. Open an issue describing the change.
2. Submit a pull request from your fork.
3. Ensure the CI is green.

## Sign-off required

All commits must be signed off (Developer Certificate of Origin).
